documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

Board Meeting Intimation for Intimation Of Board Meeting For Approval Of Un-Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Mayur Uniquoters reported Q1 FY27 standalone revenue of INR 247.03 crores and consolidated revenue of INR 269.23 crores, driven by higher export volumes and a favorable product mix. Management highlighted solid demand and order traction from U.S. automotive OEMs, while navigating raw material price volatility and elevated shipping freight costs. The company is expanding capacity in its existing premises with an additional line expected to start production by February or March 2027. Additionally, management remains focused on evaluating potential international plant locations and maintaining long-term annual guidance and margin resilience.

guidance.claim: The company targets an average growth outlook of 15% in the coming year and years.
guidance.quote: So we have said that we are targeting a 2-digit growth in the coming years. This year also and the coming years. So we have kept potential outlook for 15% growth in the coming year also.

guidance.claim: Management stated that the value growth should be around 15% for the next two years while margins remain at similar levels.
guidance.quote: Okay, value 15% for next 2 years and margin more or less similar level.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the footwear segment experienced a muted market in the last quarter due to drastically increased raw material and sole prices.
demand_outlook.quote: So obviously, the market was muted in the footwear segment.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the recent free trade agreement is a very positive move for India and will increase customer sentiments to procure from India.
demand_outlook.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that growth in the export market will be higher than growth in the domestic market.
demand_outlook.quote: Our concentration towards our export business is much more and our growth in the export market will be higher than the growth in the domestic market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the footwear business is not growing due to local competition and low price margins.
demand_outlook.quote: Our Footwear business is not growing because of local competition, because of price -- low price margin.

capex_expansion.claim: The company ordered a new line for expansion in current premises to start production by February or March 2027 with an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.
capex_expansion.quote: So we have already intimated in the last call also, so we have already ordered the line for our expansion in our current premises. So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027. So we'll have an additional production capacity of 5 lakh meters.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that total capex for financial year 2026-2027 is around INR 50 crores.
Once a decision is taken for the South plant, it takes approximately two years to start, initially adding 500,000 millimeters per month.
capex_expansion.quote: So once the decision is taken, it takes approximately 2 years for the plant to start. And we will start with 500,000 millimetres per month initially.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the sustainable gross or EBITDA margin target is 25% plus 1% or 2%.
margins_costs.quote: No. This margin is -- actually, we told you earlier also in our previous con call that margin -- sustainable margin will be 25 plus 1% or 2%.

margins_costs.claim: Management reported that shipment/freight costs for exports increased significantly during the quarter.
margins_costs.quote: And secondly, because of this war, the shipments cost have also increased. It's 4x higher, the shipment cost was increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margins to remain at similar levels and potentially go slightly better.
margins_costs.quote: Definitely, it will remain in the similar levels where we are right now, and it can go slightly better also.

margins_costs.claim: Imports normally account for nearly one-third of total raw material cost.
margins_costs.quote: Normally, imports are nearly 1/3 of our total raw material cost.

margins_costs.claim: Plasticizer and yarn prices have started going up.
margins_costs.quote: In fact, plasticizers prices have started going up. Yarn prices have started going up.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current capacity utilization is between 75% and 78%.
orders_capacity.quote: So, we are utilizing somewhere between 75% to 78%.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for PVC is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters per month.
orders_capacity.quote: So, our PVC capacity is between 3.5 million to 3.7 million meters depending on the product mix a lot, because some products have a faster line speed, some product has a slower line speed.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume for the quarter was 76.3 lakh meters, which included 2.56 lakh meters of PU.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volume has been 76.3 lakh meters, including PU, which has been 2.56 lakh meters for the quarter and value 6.17.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted that raw material prices and market conditions have been very volatile since March.
risks_headwinds.quote: And the market has been very volatile since then. The prices went up very sharply, then there was a fall in prices of some raw materials. Then again, the prices went up again. So, it's been a very volatile situation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that cheap imports and manipulation are coming from China.
risks_headwinds.quote: A lot of cheap imports are coming from China. There's a lot of manipulation.

management_commitments.claim: Management aims to make the company a preferred supplier for leading OEMs in overseas markets, especially the U.S. and European regions.
management_commitments.quote: Further, our endeavor is to make the company as a preferred supplier for the leading OEMs in overseas market, especially the U.S. and European regions.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects sales growth and increased momentum to continue in the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

management_commitments.claim: Production from the new expansion line in current premises is expected to start by February or March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: So we should be able to start our production by -- towards the end of this financial year, somewhere between February, March 2027.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects U.S. automotive business to increase by 60% to 70% over the next three years.
management_commitments.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right?

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the increased momentum in export orders from the US to continue in the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: And in addition to this, we have already received some good export orders from US for OEM supply and resulting into good contribution to our top line and bottom line. And this increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
